aes.name: AES Encrypt / Decrypt
aes.description: Encrypt or decrypt text with AES-256-GCM and a passphrase (PBKDF2), all local.
aes.keywords: aes, encrypt, decrypt, gcm, pbkdf2, cipher, symmetric, passphrase
aes.note: AES-256-GCM, key derived with PBKDF2 (100k iterations). Encrypted locally. Keep your passphrase safe, it cannot be recovered.

errors.tooShort: Ciphertext is too short or malformed.
errors.decryptFailed: Decryption failed: wrong passphrase or corrupted data.

basic-auth-generator.name: Basic Auth Generator
basic-auth-generator.description: Turn a username and password into an HTTP Basic Authorization header, locally.
basic-auth-generator.keywords: basic auth, authorization, header, credentials, username, password, curl, base64
basic-auth-generator.note: Basic auth only Base64-encodes credentials, it does not encrypt them. Always send it over HTTPS.

bcrypt-tool.name: Bcrypt Hash & Verify
bcrypt-tool.description: Hash a password with bcrypt at a chosen cost, or verify one against a hash, locally.
bcrypt-tool.keywords: bcrypt, hash, password, verify, salt, cost, rounds, compare
bcrypt-tool.hashNote: Higher cost is slower to compute and to attack. Each hash includes its own random salt, so hashing the same password twice differs.

bip39-generator.name: BIP39 Mnemonic Generator
bip39-generator.description: Generate and validate BIP39 recovery mnemonics with entropy and seed, locally.
bip39-generator.keywords: bip39, mnemonic, seed, phrase, recovery, wallet, crypto, entropy, generator
bip39-generator.validatePlaceholder: Paste a mnemonic to check its checksum…
bip39-generator.note: Generated locally with the Web Crypto API. Still, never enter a mnemonic that protects real funds into any website.

hash-generator.name: Hash & HMAC Generator
hash-generator.description: Compute SHA-1/256/384/512 digests and HMACs in your browser via Web Crypto.
hash-generator.keywords: hash, sha, sha256, sha512, hmac, digest, checksum, signature
hash-generator.note: Computed locally with Web Crypto. MD5 is not offered (unsupported by Web Crypto and cryptographically broken).

id-generator.name: ID Generator
id-generator.description: Generate GUIDs, UUID v4, time-sortable UUID v7 and ULIDs locally, in bulk.
id-generator.keywords: guid, uuid, uuidv4, uuidv7, ulid, id, identifier, random, unique

jwt-decoder.name: JWT Decoder
jwt-decoder.description: Decode a JSON Web Token's header and payload and inspect its claims, locally.
jwt-decoder.keywords: jwt, token, json web token, bearer, auth, claims, decode
jwt-decoder.notVerified: Decoded locally. The signature is not verified: this shows the token contents, not that it is trusted.

errors.segments: A JWT has 2 or 3 dot-separated segments.
errors.header: Header is not valid Base64URL-encoded JSON.
errors.payload: Payload is not valid Base64URL-encoded JSON.

password-generator.name: Password & Key Generator
password-generator.description: Generate strong random passwords and encryption keys (hex/base64) in your browser.
password-generator.keywords: password, key, generator, random, secret, encryption key, token, entropy
password-generator.noCharset: Select at least one character set.

password-strength-analyser.name: Password Strength Analyser
password-strength-analyser.description: Estimate a password's entropy and crack time from its character sets, locally.
password-strength-analyser.keywords: password, strength, entropy, crack, time, analyze, analyser, secure, bits
password-strength-analyser.note: Entropy assumes random characters. A memorable phrase with dictionary words is weaker than its raw entropy suggests. Nothing is sent anywhere.

rsa-keygen.name: RSA Key Generator
rsa-keygen.description: Generate an RSA public/private key pair in PEM format, in your browser via Web Crypto.
rsa-keygen.keywords: rsa, key, keypair, pem, public key, private key, generate
rsa-keygen.note: Generated locally with Web Crypto (RSA-OAEP, SHA-256). Your private key never leaves the browser.

totp-generator.name: TOTP Generator & Validator
totp-generator.description: Generate time-based one-time codes (RFC 6238) from a secret, with a QR code and validator, locally.
totp-generator.keywords: totp, otp, 2fa, mfa, authenticator, one-time, code, hotp, rfc6238, google authenticator
